command:
set -eu
sudo -n tee /usr/local/sbin/setup-srv-data-loop >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
backing=/var/lib/srv-data/pv.img
loopdev=$(losetup -j "$backing" | sed -n '1s/:.*//p')
if [ -z "$loopdev" ]; then
    loopdev=$(losetup --find --show "$backing")
fi
pvscan --cache "$loopdev" >/dev/null
vgchange -ay srvdata_vg >/dev/null
udevadm settle
ANTRIEB_SCRIPT
sudo -n chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/setup-srv-data-loop
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/srv-data-loop.service >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Attach loop PV and activate srvdata LVM volume
After=systemd-udevd.service
Before=srv-data.mount
ConditionPathExists=/var/lib/srv-data/pv.img

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/setup-srv-data-loop
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_UNIT
uuid=$(sudo -n blkid -s UUID -o value /dev/srvdata_vg/srvdata_lv)
if ! grep -qE '[[:space:]]/srv/data[[:space:]]' /etc/fstab; then
  printf 'UUID=%s /srv/data ext4 defaults,x-systemd.requires=srv-data-loop.service 0 2\n' "$uuid" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab >/dev/null
fi
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable srv-data-loop.service
sudo -n systemctl start srv-data-loop.service
sudo -n mount -a
printf 'filesystem_uuid=%s\n' "$uuid"
systemctl is-enabled srv-data-loop.service
systemctl is-active srv-data-loop.service
grep -E '[[:space:]]/srv/data[[:space:]]' /etc/fstab
findmnt -no SOURCE,FSTYPE,SIZE,TARGET /srv/data

set -eu
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/srv-data-loop.service >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Attach loop PV and activate srvdata LVM volume
DefaultDependencies=no
After=systemd-udevd.service
Before=srv-data.mount local-fs.target
ConditionPathExists=/var/lib/srv-data/pv.img

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/setup-srv-data-loop
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs-pre.target
ANTRIEB_UNIT
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl reenable srv-data-loop.service
sudo -n systemctl start srv-data.mount
printf '%s\n' '--- dependency verification ---'
systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/srv-data-loop.service /etc/systemd/system/srv-data.mount
printf '%s\n' '--- current health ---'
systemctl is-active srv-data-loop.service
systemctl is-active srv-data.mount
